architecture.title: System Architecture
architecture.description: MYRAD follows a modular, decentralized architecture combining blockchain logic, backend orchestration, and an interactive frontend.

problem.title: The Problem
problem.description: In today's data economy, datasets are often locked behind centralized platforms or sold through opaque intermediaries.

README.title: MYRAD: Decentralized Data Marketplace
README.description: MYRAD is a decentralized data marketplace for tokenizing, trading, and monetizing datasets.

vision.title: Vision & Roadmap
vision.description: MYRAD aims to redefine data as a digital asset class — empowering creators, buyers, and researchers to interact freely without intermediaries.

why-this.title: Why MYRAD
why-this.description: MYRAD transforms how data is owned, priced, and distributed.
